pp.document_type = 'FACTORING' and pp.document_category='PRJ_PROJECT' AND NVL( pp.data_class, 'N' ) != 'VIRTUAL_CON'
and pp.project_number like concat('%',concat(#{projectNumber},'%'))
and pp.project_name like concat('%',concat(#{projectName},'%'))
and ( SELECT bp_name FROM hls_bp_master hbm WHERE hbm.bp_id = pp.tenant_id ) like concat('%',concat(#{tenantIdN},'%'))
and pp.industry like concat('%', concat(#{industry},'%'))
and pp.creation_date >= to_date(#{creationDateFrom},'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
and pp.creation_date < to_date(#{creationDateTo},'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')+1
and pp.project_status = #{projectStatus}
and pp.credit_flag = #{creditFlag}
order by pp.project_number DESC

SELECT pp.project_id, pp.project_number, pp.project_name, pp.industry, pp.tenant_id, ( SELECT hbv.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master hbv WHERE hbv.bp_id = pp.tenant_id ) tenant_id_n, pp.company_id, ( SELECT FC.COMPANY_FULL_NAME FROM FND_COMPANY FC WHERE pp.COMPANY_ID = FC.COMPANY_ID ) COMPANY_ID_N, pp.creation_date, pp.unit_id, ( SELECT fou.unit_name FROM fnd_org_unit fou WHERE pp.unit_id = fou.unit_id ) unit_id_n, pp.host_project_manager, ( SELECT su.description FROM sys_user su WHERE su.user_id = pp.host_project_manager ) host_project_manager_n, pp.assist_project_manager, ( SELECT a.description FROM sys_user a WHERE a.user_id = pp.assist_project_manager ) assist_project_manager_n, pp.city, ( SELECT CONCAT( ( SELECT P.DESCRIPTION FROM FND_PROVINCE P WHERE to_char( P.PROVINCE ) = fd.PROVINCE ), CONCAT( ( SELECT fc.DESCRIPTION FROM FND_CITY fc WHERE to_char( fc.City ) = fd.City ), fd.DESCRIPTION ) ) FROM fnd_district fd WHERE fd.DISTRICT = pp.city AND fd.enabled_flag = 'Y' ) CITY_N, pp.factoring_type, ( SELECT sc.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v sc WHERE sc.code = 'CHANCE.FACTORING_TYPE' AND sc.code_value = pp.factoring_type ) factoring_type_n, pp.factoring_category, ( SELECT sc.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v sc WHERE sc.code = 'CHANCE.FACTORING_CATEGORY' AND sc.code_value = pp.factoring_category ) factoring_category_n, pp.factoring_recourse, ( SELECT sc.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v sc WHERE sc.code = 'CHANCE.FACTORING_RECOURSE' AND sc.code_value = pp.factoring_recourse ) factoring_recourse_n, pp.factoring_open, ( SELECT sc.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v sc WHERE sc.code = 'CHANCE.FACTORING_OPEN' AND sc.code_value = pp.factoring_open ) factoring_open_n, pp.industry_type, ( SELECT hsc.description FROM hls_stat_class hsc WHERE to_char( hsc.class_id ) = pp.industry_type AND hsc.enabled_flag = 'Y' ) industry_type_n, pp.description, pp.credit_measures, pp.finance_note, pp.prj_info_desc, pp.creditor_analyse, pp.debtor_analyse, pp.other_desc, pp.spot_check_desc, pp.risk_invest_desc FROM PRJ_PROJECT pp where pp.project_id = #{projectId}

select p.project_number, p.project_id, p.chance_id, p.project_name, p.tenant_id, (SELECT m.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master m WHERE m.bp_id = p.tenant_id) as tenant_id_n, p.credit_flag, (SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.CODE = 'GT.HCLC.CREDIT_FLAG' AND p.CREDIT_FLAG = v.CODE_VALUE) AS credit_flag_n, p.lease_item_amount, p.host_project_manager, (SELECT su.description FROM sys_user su WHERE su.user_id = p.host_project_manager) host_project_manager_n, p.assist_project_manager, (SELECT a.description FROM sys_user a WHERE a.user_id = p.assist_project_manager) assist_project_manager_n, p.project_status, (SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.CODE = 'CHANCE.FACTORING_PRJ_STATUS' AND v.code_value = p.project_status) project_status_n, p.approved_date from prj_project p
p.document_type = 'CREDIT'
and p.project_number like concat('%',concat(#{projectNumber},'%'))
and p.project_name like concat('%',concat(#{projectName},'%'))
and p.tenant_id_n like concat('%',concat(#{tenantIdN},'%'))
and p.host_project_manager like concat('%',concat(#{hostProjectManager},'%'))
and business_type like concat('%',concat(#{businessType},'%'))
AND lease_item_amount_from BETWEEN #{leaseItemAmountFrom} AND #{leaseItemAmountTo}
and assist_project_manager like concat('%',concat(#{assistProjectManager},'%'))
AND TO_CHAR(approved_time, 'yyyy-MM-dd') BETWEEN #{approvedTimeFrom} AND #{approvedTimeTo}
and project_status like concat('%',concat(#{projectStatus},'%'))
and credit_flag = #{creditFlag}

SELECT pp.CONTRACT_NUMBER, pp.PROJECT_NUMBER, pp.PROJECT_NAME, hbm.bp_name TENANT_ID_N, pp.TENANT_ID, pp.CREDIT_FLAG, (SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.CODE = 'GT.HCLC.CREDIT_FLAG' AND pp.CREDIT_FLAG = v.CODE_VALUE) AS credit_flag_n, pp.LEASE_ITEM_AMOUNT, pp.INDUSTRY, pp.HOST_PROJECT_MANAGER, (SELECT a.description FROM sys_user a WHERE a.user_id = pp.host_project_manager) host_project_manager_n, pp.ASSIST_PROJECT_MANAGER, (SELECT a.description FROM sys_user a WHERE a.user_id = pp.ASSIST_PROJECT_MANAGER) assist_project_manager_n, pp.CONTRACT_STATUS, (select v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.code = 'HLS.WORK_FLOW_STATUS' AND v.code_value = pp.contract_status) contract_status_n, pp.CONTRACT_END_DATE, pp.PROJECT_ID, pp.document_type, pp.document_category, pp.data_class FROM PRJ_PROJECT pp LEFT JOIN hls_bp_master hbm ON hbm.bp_id = pp.TENANT_ID
pp.document_type = 'FACTORING' AND pp.document_category = 'PRJ_PROJECT' AND pp.data_class = 'VIRTUAL_CON'
and pp.project_id = #{projectId}
and pp.contract_number like concat('%',concat(#{contractNumber},'%'))
and pp.PROJECT_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{projectName},'%'))
and hbm.bp_name like concat('%',concat(#{tenantIdN},'%'))
and pp.contract_status = #{contractStatus}

tenant_id_n, p.credit_flag, (SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.CODE = 'GT.HCLC.CREDIT_FLAG' AND p.CREDIT_FLAG = v.CODE_VALUE) AS credit_flag_n, p.lease_item_amount,
